name: Aegis Site X-ray
description: Passive security posture inspector reviewing HTTP response headers and security attributes.
notes: Permissions (honest disclosure): webRequest + <all_urls> are BROAD permissions granting read access to response headers of every site (passive, non-blocking onHeadersReceived for main_frame only). This is intentionally NOT least privilege; a narrower scope cannot audit arbitrary visited sites. storage = enabled flag only (Privacy Class P1: local configuration only). The 'tabs' permission is NOT requested: tab lifecycle events work without it and tab URLs are not needed. Header VALUES and Set-Cookie contents (including cookie names) are never stored or logged - only derived booleans, counters, and the origin are kept in memory. Cross-module messaging: externally_connectable is declared for portability but Gecko does NOT enforce it (measured on ESR 153.5.1; the rogue-extension test proves delivery happens). The ENFORCED defense is the background service's sender.id allowlist of Aegis module IDs, which ignores all other senders (verified by a live rogue-extension test). No network egress.
